purpose: Cross-client dict-zstd interop test fixture. Each Codec client (TS, Python, Rust, Java, .NET, C) MUST decompress compressed.bin using dict.bin and produce decompressed.bin byte-identically. Then msgpack-parse decompressed.bin and verify the token-ID sequence matches expected_token_ids.

client_contract.step_1: Load dict.bin into a hash registry keyed by 'sha256:<lowercase hex>'.
client_contract.step_2: On receiving a response with Content-Encoding: zstd + Codec-Zstd-Dict: sha256:..., look up the dict bytes in the registry.
client_contract.step_3: Pass the dict to a zstd decompressor (zstd-jni Dictionary, zstandard.ZstdCompressionDict, ZstdSharp.DecompressionDictionary, libzstd ZSTD_DDict, etc.).
client_contract.step_4: Stream-decompress the response body. The result MUST be byte-identical to decompressed.bin.
client_contract.step_5: Msgpack-parse the decompressed bytes. The concatenated frames MUST yield expected_token_count token IDs starting with expected_first_10_ids.
